BiblicalUsage: Harhur is named twice, among the children of the Nethinim who returned from exile with Zerubbabel. Both lists place his family among the temple servants who came back to serve.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the return list is a roll call of the lowly: Harhur's family came home with the priests and the singers.
